turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Phoenix is actually beautiful today, nice and clear. And yes, I did bake a loaf of sourdough this morning! It was nice because I didn't have to do any driving to get to the clinic today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that sounds like a perfect Sunday morning. It’s always great when you don't have to worry about a work commute. Did you spend the rest of the day relaxing?

turns.text: I did! I was cleaning up the kitchen and decided to listen to some music instead of my usual comedy podcasts. Usually, I'll put on a funny show, but today I really wanted something upbeat to keep my energy up.

turns.text: Music is perfect for kitchen cleanup! What kind of music did you put on?

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He did! He came over after it cooled down, and we had some slices. He loved how the crust turned out this time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great to hear! How are you feeling overall? I know you recovered from that nasty flu a while ago, but have you felt completely back to your usual self at the outpatient clinic?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, absolutely! I'm completely back to one hundred percent. Working my shifts at the clinic has been much easier now that my energy is fully back.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm so glad. It must have been rough working those day shifts while still recovering. Did you ever end up listening to that true-crime podcast your coworker recommended to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not yet! I still have it saved on my phone, but like I said, today was all about the upbeat music. I'll probably check it out sometime soon when I'm in a different mood.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes total sense, sometimes you just need those high-energy tunes. I hope you and Tom have a wonderful rest of your Sunday evening!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! We are just going to relax and watch a movie. Talk to you tomorrow!
